htmlChunks:
There is no exact, single-word English anagram for "tomato". When you rearrange all six letters (A, M, O, O, T, T), the only full six-letter word they form is tomato itself. 
However, you can create the following multi-word phrases or smaller words: 
Two-Word Phrases
If you use all the letters to make two words, you can create: 
  • Atom to
  • Moat to
  • Ma Otto
  • Ma toot 
Smaller Words Inside "Tomato"
If you do not need to use every letter, you can form these smaller words: 
  • 5 Letters: Motto
  • 4 Letters: Atom, Moat, Moot, Toot, Otto, Matt
  • 3 Letters: Tom, Mat, Tot, Moo, Oat, Tao 
If you add just one letter—the letter N—you can create the 7-letter anagram Ottoman.
